issues.problem: gv-kudasaru mistake note said 'に marks the source', which reads as if に were a source marker with くださる; muddled.
issues.action: Reworded: with the teacher marked に (the source), I am the receiving subject, so いただく.

issues.problem: gv-yaru explain said 'never' use やる to a friend; rough casual speech between close friends does use it, so the absolute claim is false.
issues.action: Softened to 'do not', noting only rough casual talk between close friends tolerates it.

issues.problem: x-give mistake 私は姉にかばんをくれました had two possible fixes (もらいました or あげました) since に can mark either role; the given fix was not forced.
issues.action: Changed に to から so the receiving reading (もらいました) is the only fix.

issues.problem: x-give mistake 田中さんは母に花をあげました is grammatical and used in neutral narration; くれました is preferred but あげました is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced with 私は友達に誕生日のプレゼントをくれました → あげました (私 is never the giver of くれる).

issues.problem: x-give-te examples translated 駅まで送って as 'gave me a lift', assuming a car; 送る can equally be walking someone there.
issues.action: Changed English to 'took me to the station' / 'had my friend take me to the station'.

issues.problem: x-give-te mistake 隣の人が傘を貸しました is grammatical (lent an umbrella to someone); nothing in the sentence makes it wrong.
issues.action: Added 私に to both bad and good so the receiver is me and the missing てくれる is the error; reworded note.
